name: checkout_cheapest_in_category
description: Buy the cheapest item in a category, then complete payment.
body:
search_and_filter(obs, query=query, category=category, sort='price_asc')
click_text(obs, text='first_result')
click_text(obs, text='Add to Cart')
click_text(obs, text='Checkout')
type_in_field(obs, label='PaymentToken', value=payment_token)
click_text(obs, text='Place Order')
